diaz2019improved: efficient covariate-adjusted RMST under ordinary follow-up, not the quadratic endpoint model.
westling2024inference: survival-score drift decomposition; the stated integrated quadratic-factor cancellation is not supplied.
stute1995clt and jingShaoWang2003selfnormalized supply the respective endpoint-integrability and weak-moment ingredients, not this conditional causal envelope.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Theorem 1 gives a whole-support uniform probability-concentration rate for a boundary-adaptive local-polynomial conditional-density estimator under ordinary nondegenerate i.i.d. information.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Specify the direct one-dimensional local-cubic regression equation for the propensity in def:endpoint-learning-handle, including its deterministic fallback, so every nuisance named in the simultaneous concentration target has an explicit construction route.

Develop the retained beta-endpoint phase-diagram seed into a separate theorem with a derived regularity threshold, feasible-attainability region, and an impossibility or least-favorable construction beyond it.
Add a boundary corollary that states precisely how the fixed-horizon theorem reduces to the positive-follow-up RMST regime at tau=1-delta, with the factor-preserving learner retained.

recommended_next_step: Advance this field-tier kernel to Stage 0, beginning with the terminal-cell concentration OEQ and its total learner construction.
